title: User Authentication with Microsoft Entra ID for Single Sign-on

facts.text: WS-Federation support deprecated; removed in 2023 release wave 1 (version 22) and later
OpenID Connect introduced in 2022 release wave 1 (version 20); recommended replacement
Security certificates required on server and client computers to secure connections
Create or obtain Microsoft Entra tenant for managing user accounts and app registration
Register Business Central application in Microsoft Entra tenant with redirect URI and application ID
Associate each Business Central user with their Microsoft Entra user principal name as authentication email
Configure server instance with WS-Federation login endpoint and metadata location parameters
WS-Federation no longer supported in version 22 and later; must migrate to OpenID Connect
